title: Canonical universal tensor cohomology cofans are colimiting
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in universe u with R-algebras A,B and an E=A tensor_R B-algebra C. Assume derived categories of R- and B-modules. Universal base-derived tensor cohomology models are as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let M_j be A-module cochain complexes indexed by I:Type u, and let s_j:M_j to S be a colimiting cofan. Choose models m_j,m_S and a degree i. Let δ_j:m_j.derived to m_S.derived be counit-compatible natural transformations, and g_j:m_j.cohomology(i) to m_S.cohomology(i) E-linear maps whose restriction to B, after the cohomology identifications, is H^i(m_j.derived(s_j)) followed by H^i(δ_j at the restricted S). Then the E-module cofan with vertex m_S.cohomology(i) and legs g_j is colimiting. This statement is before further scalar extension to C, has no localized comparison equation, and includes empty I, zero rings and arbitrary unbounded complexes.

source.place: Tag 06Y6, K-flat computation and independence of the derived change of rings; coproduct argument with Tag 07D9 (injectives.tex); localized counit comparison in Tag 08IB and the calculation used in Tag 0DJA(1). proof.text: Restriction of scalars preserves coproducts, and mapHomologicalComplex preserves these degreewise. Apply derivedModuleDirectSums to the restricted family to show that DerivedCategory.Q preserves its coproduct, then transport through quotientCompQhIso to the quotient followed by Qh.

Use the fully proved private scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_kFlat helper from Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.KFlatScalarExtensionDerivedIso (import all). It specializes mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso to the B tensor unit in degree zero and transports via mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso and the left unitor. This supplies extendScalars.PreservesKFlatQuasiIso. The already proved source-library Adjunction.derivedAdjunction, with module functorial flat resolutions and Grothendieck K-injective resolutions, makes the standard leftDerivedFunctor a left adjoint. Thus it preserves coproducts. Functor.leftDerivedNatIso identifies this standard functor with mS.derived; preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso transfers preservation. These steps are the fully proved private helper derivedExtension_preservesCoproducts, with no new assumptions.

Apply mS.derived to the restricted derived coproduct, then derivedModuleHomology_coproduct in degree i. Counit compatibility and leftDerived_ext identify every δ_j with the invertible leftDerivedNatIso. Form the diagram isomorphism with components m_j.cohomologyIso followed by homology of δ_j at the restricted M_j. Naturality of δ_j at s_j and hg identify its legs. Precompose the fixed homology cofan by this diagram isomorphism, and transport its apex by the inverse of mS.cohomologyIso. The resulting B-module cofan has exactly the restricted legs g_j.

Restriction from E=A tensor_R B to B preserves coproducts and reflects isomorphisms. Mathlib reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms therefore reflects the colimit just proved. Apply isColimitOfIsColimitCofanMkObj and package the result in Nonempty. The argument is uniform for empty I, zero rings and unbounded complexes; it uses no scalar action calculation beyond the fact that g_j are E-linear.

theorem baseDerivedTensorCohomology_canonical_cofan
    {I : Type u} (M : I → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (S : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (s : ∀ j, M j ⟶ S)
    (hs : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S s))
    (m : ∀ j, BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (M j) C)
    (mS : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B S C) (i : ℤ)
    (δ : ∀ j, (m j).derived ⟶ mS.derived)
    (g : ∀ j, (m j).cohomology i ⟶ mS.cohomology i)
    (hδ : ∀ j, Functor.whiskerLeft (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := ModuleCat.{u} R)) (δ j) ≫
      mS.counit = (m j).counit)
    (hg : ∀ j, (restrictScalars.{u}
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B).toRingHom).map (g j) ≫
          (mS.cohomologyIso i).hom =
      ((m j).cohomologyIso i).hom ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
          ((m j).derived.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).map
              (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).map (s j))))) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i).map
          ((δ j).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).obj
              (((restrictScalars.{u} (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj S))))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (mS.cohomology i) g))
